name: Care for Me
summary:
A little friend sits alone in the rain on a small meadow island, and the whole world has turned grey. Wave hello, let it come closer and stroke it gently – colour and sunshine return.

Choose your friend: gentle Keri, a little dragon with tiny horns, or cheerful Mimi, a baby axolotl girl.

Care for Me is a calm, cozy VR experience for kids and families, made to be enjoyed together with a parent. Along the way, children practise recognising emotions and calming down with slow breaths.
